boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Toledo destinations on corridors in the practical orbit of Mercy College of Ohio, each with one source-backed reason to go.

cards.title: Toledo Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street corridor
cards.notes: Head to 2445 Monroe Street for the galleries that remain open during the museum’s renovation; check the current gallery map before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A free museum stop with currently open galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists 2445 Monroe Street, free general admission, and identifies galleries that remain open during renovations.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Toledo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesday through Sunday; gallery availability is subject to the museum’s renovation notice.

cards.entity_name: Toledo Museum of Art Glass Pavilion
cards.title: Toledo Museum of Art Glass Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Monroe Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the Glass Pavilion at 2444 Monroe Street as a focused stop for the museum’s glass collection, then cross at a marked Monroe Street crossing if needed.
cards.short_summary: A named museum building dedicated to glass.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s visitor page lists the Glass Pavilion at 2444 Monroe Street and states that general admission is free.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Toledo Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Check the museum’s current visitor information and gallery map before visiting.

cards.title: Collingwood Arts Center
cards.subtitle: Collingwood Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Check the center’s calendar, then visit its 2413 Collingwood Boulevard building for a look at its studios, theaters, and historic mansion.
cards.short_summary: A historic arts center with studios and theaters.
cards.evidence_claim: The Collingwood Arts Center identifies itself as an Old West End arts hub with more than 80 active studios, three theaters, and a historic mansion.
cards.access_notes: Programs and building access vary; consult the center directly before going inside.

cards.entity_name: Toledo Lucas County Public Library Main Library
cards.title: Toledo Lucas County Public Library Main Library
cards.subtitle: Michigan Street corridor
cards.notes: Bring a project or a book list to 325 Michigan Street and use the branch’s posted hours; the attached garage is entered from Adams Street.
cards.short_summary: A downtown library branch with study-oriented amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists its Main Library at 325 Michigan Street, with posted hours and an attached covered parking garage entered from Adams Street.
cards.source_title: Main Library | Toledo Lucas County Public Library
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by day; verify current branch hours before departure.

cards.title: Imagination Station
cards.subtitle: Summit Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan a hands-on science visit at 1 Discovery Way, at Summit and Adams streets; use the venue’s parking guidance before heading downtown.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront science center at a named downtown corner.
cards.evidence_claim: Imagination Station lists its location as 1 Discovery Way at the corner of Summit and Adams streets and describes hands-on exhibits.
cards.access_notes: Review current admission and parking details on the visitor page.

cards.title: Promenade Park
cards.subtitle: Water Street corridor
cards.notes: Use Promenade Park at 400 Water Street as a riverfront meeting point, and check the city calendar for an all-ages public program before you go.
cards.short_summary: A city riverfront park used for public programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Toledo lists Promenade Park at 400 Water Street and identifies it as a location for community events and activities.
cards.source_title: The Juneteenth Experience | City of Toledo
cards.access_notes: Event timing and any event-specific costs vary; consult the city’s current listing.

cards.title: Huntington Center
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the event calendar and ticket details before heading to the arena at 500 Jefferson Avenue; its box office also sells tickets in person.
cards.short_summary: A Jefferson Avenue arena for scheduled events.
cards.evidence_claim: Huntington Center lists its address as 500 Jefferson Avenue and states that concert, hockey, and event tickets are available through its box office or Ticketmaster.
cards.access_notes: Entry depends on the scheduled event; tickets and venue policies apply.

cards.title: Fifth Third Field
cards.subtitle: Washington Street corridor
cards.notes: Check the Mud Hens schedule and entry guidance before going to 406 Washington Street; use the listed gate information for your planned visit.
cards.short_summary: A Washington Street ballpark and home of the Toledo Mud Hens.
cards.evidence_claim: The Toledo Mud Hens identify Fifth Third Field at 406 Washington Street as their ballpark and provide ticket, gate, and parking information.
cards.source_title: Fifth Third Field | Toledo Mud Hens
cards.access_notes: Game and event attendance requires the applicable ticket; consult the team’s current schedule.

cards.title: Toledo Farmers' Market
cards.subtitle: Market Street corridor
cards.notes: Visit 525 Market Street during the posted Saturday market window, and bring a payment method if you plan to buy from vendors.
cards.short_summary: A year-round Saturday market in the Warehouse District.
cards.evidence_claim: The Toledo Farmers’ Market lists its location at 525 Market Street and posts Saturday winter and spring-to-fall market hours.
cards.access_notes: Hours change seasonally; confirm the posted market schedule before travel.

cards.title: Middlegrounds Metropark
cards.subtitle: Ottawa Street corridor
cards.notes: Start at 111 Ottawa Street and follow the designated walk/bike path for a riverfront break; plan to leave before the park’s posted closing time.
cards.short_summary: A downtown riverfront park with a walk/bike path.
cards.evidence_claim: Metroparks Toledo lists Middlegrounds Metropark at 111 Ottawa Street with a half-mile of river frontage and a 1.5-mile walk/bike path.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7 a.m. until dark, according to Metroparks Toledo.
